Commonwealth Champion Phillips Idowu and Samson Oni set Championship Bests in triple and high jumps, Bernard Yeboah took the long jump while the pole vault saw a 1-2 from Joe Ive and Cameron Johnston.

Joe Ive equalled the winning height in the pole vault but we missed Cameron Johnston who pulled out the day before with a virus. Richard Danso gained a third spot in the long jump and it was a big blow when Darragh O’Farrell failed to appear for the long and triple.

Cameron Johnston, with a late start to his season, looked comfortable at 4.40m in the pole vault and young guns Kwesi Menyah and Melvyn Anukam welcomed the chance to step up from Southern League competition.
New man Kwesi Menyah did some useful triple jumping and Cameron Johnston's 4.40 pole vaulting, backed up by Louis Samms was a tonic in the jumps department.
Sadly bad luck again dogged the pole vault as Keith Higham picked up a nasty injury in the warm up but Cameron Johnston made some amends by finishing a commendable third in windy conditions.
